name: Jiangxi Guotai Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi Guotai Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the civil explosives, military new materials, rail transit automation, and information technology businesses in China. The company offers industrial explosives, such as permitted emulsion explosives for grade III coal mines; no. 2 rock emulsion explosive; packaged emulsified granular ammonium oil explosives; and expanded ammonium nitrate explosive.
